description: 303 Oscillator: the oscillator of a TB-303, with its slide circuit and a voltage-controlled morph from saw to square

params.text: Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, -3 to +3
Tunes the pitch, up to 7 semitones either way
Sets how long a slide takes, 2ms to 360ms
Sets the shape of the square wave, -100 to +100%
Morphs the wave from saw to square
Attenuverts the slide-time CV input; at full, 10V covers the whole slide-time range
Attenuverts the square shape CV input
Chooses whether the FM input is read as exponential pitch or as linear through-zero frequency, marked EXP and TZ

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, one octave per volt
Slides to the current pitch while it is high; it rises at 1V and releases below 0.1V
Shifts the slide time, scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the frequency, read as exponential pitch or as linear through-zero frequency
Shifts the square shape, scaled by its attenuverter
Shifts the saw-to-square morph, scaled by its attenuverter
Resets the oscillator, with the crossing located between samples so the sync stays clean

outputs.text: The pitch after the slide circuit, as a 1V/octave voltage for a filter to follow
